newsitem.title: FRANCE: France raises estimate for 1996 oilseeds crop.
newsitem.headline: France raises estimate for 1996 oilseeds crop.

text.p: The French farm ministry said on Friday it raised its estimate for the national 1996 oilseeds crop to 5.134 million tonnes from a previous target of 5.104 million.
This would represent a rise of 1.9 percent over the 5.037 million tonnes produced in 1995.

In its report dated November 1 the ministry's statistical service SCEES marginally raised its estimate for the 1996 rapeseed crop to 2.898 million tonnes from a previous target of 2.890 million. France produced 2.789 million tonnes of rapeseed in 1995.
The ministry also raised its target for the sunflower crop to 1.996 million tonnes from 1.973 million last month and 1.987 million last year.

France's relatively small soybean crop was revised down to 240,000 tonnes from last month's estimate of 242,000. This would represent a fall of some eight percent from the 261,000 tonnes produced in 1995.
